## 0 · Read these first
Nothing in the repo matters. All context is below.

## 1 · Status
🟢 This was a multi-topic advice chat with no open deliverable, no files edited and no jobs running. Every chat sub-session is dated **Sat 2023-04-29** (the user's timeline). Treat "now" for the user as 2023-04-29 when working out relative dates.

## 2 · Picture
The user asked for practical lifestyle advice across eight separate chat sessions on 2023-04-29. Topics: Instagram/Facebook marketing for a handmade jewelry business; brain/cognitive enhancement ethics; Bible-verse productivity guides; a Moab, Utah trip; wolf dialects; a Colorado Rockies/Aspen trip; hiking gear for a New Zealand trek; healthy snacks after a charity 5K. No question is left hanging. The user will most likely come back with follow-ups that test whether we remember **their personal facts and numbers** (section 5) and **what we recommended** (section 6b).

## 3 · Next actions
1. Answer whatever the user asks next, using the facts below. Done when the answer stays consistent with sections 5 and 6b.
2. If the user returns to a topic where an earlier answer was likely wrong (section 7), correct it briefly instead of repeating it.

## 5 · Who the user is (all [user said], all stated 2023-04-29)
**Business**
- Sells **handmade jewelry** to young adults who want unique accessories. Keywords: "handmade jewelry", "unique accessories", "indie fashion".
- Recently worked with an **influencer who promoted the product to her 10,000 followers**: "a great success".
- Uses Instagram Stories to show the production process and ask for feedback on new products. Ran a **poll last week (~2023-04-22) on favourite product design: ~50 people voted**.
- **Previous Facebook ad campaign: reached ~2,000 people, got 50 clicks to the website** (we calculated a 2.5% CTR). Planning another campaign that targets people interested in similar products.

**Travel, chronological** (relative times converted using 2023-04-29)
- **Feb 2023**: 7-day **family road trip in Utah**, lots of driving and hiking, **no camping** that time.
- **~March 2023** ("last month", said 2023-04-29): **5-day camping trip to Yellowstone** (mentioned in the Colorado chat). Also referred to rocky, uneven "trails I encountered in Yellowstone last month" in the boots chat.
- **Early April 2023**: **3-day solo camping trip to Big Sur**. The current boots "did okay", but the user wants better ones.
- **Upcoming**: Moab, Utah trip (interested in beginner off-roading, bike rentals, an Island in the Sky day trip, White Rim Road permits).
- **Upcoming**: Colorado Rockies/Aspen trip. Plan: Maroon Bells hike on day 1 with an early start (to beat the crowds), then the town in the afternoon (casual, affordable lunch; boutiques and galleries), plus a scenic drive on a rest day.
- **Nov 2023**: **10-day trek in New Zealand** on varying and rocky terrain. Will bring a portable stove and pot (wants something light, compact and wind-resistant), and prefers a **water filter over tablets** so they don't have to carry many tablets.

**Other**
- **2023-04-29**: did a **5 km charity walk with work colleagues** for a local food bank ("great team-building experience"). **The team raised over $1,500; the user personally contributed $200.**
- Loves bananas and has heard avocados are good for you. Wanted something sweet and is keen to try new recipes.
- Interests: neuroscience and enhancement ethics (worried about new inequality), wolf and animal communication/dialects, Christian faith (asked for guides with Bible verses plus suggested resources and ideas).

**Taste** (inferred, nothing explicitly corrected): the user likes structured, bulleted, practical lists. For the Bible-guide requests they asked for "effective, practical, research-based, innovative, creative, underrated or overlooked" methods, each with a Bible verse **and** resources or ideas. The user never pushed back on length.

## 6b · What I told the user (they may ask again)
- **Hashtags**: #handmadejewelry (1.4M+), #handmadeshop, #handcraftedjewelry, #jewelrymaking, #handmadewithlove; #uniqueaccessories, #accessorize, #jewelrylover, #fashionaccessories, #statementaccessories; #indiefashion, #alternativefashion, #bohofashion, #indiestyle, #fashionrebel. Advice: 5–10 hashtags per post, plus a branded hashtag. (The post counts were made up [assumed], so don't defend them.)
- **FB ads**: CTR = 50/2000 = **2.5%** ("decent"). Tips: lookalike/custom audiences, exclusions, retargeting, test creatives, improve the landing page.
- **Moab**: Arches/Delicate Arch, Canyonlands, Dead Horse Point. Trails: Fisher Towers, Grandstaff, Chesler Park. Bike shops: Poison Spider, Chile Pepper, Moab Cyclery. Spring and fall are best. Easter Jeep Safari is late March/April. For Island in the Sky: Mesa Arch, Grand View Point, Upheaval Dome. White Rim Road: permit needed, high clearance, usually 2–3 days.
- **Aspen**: Maroon Bells (I said 10 mi out-and-back, ~1,500 ft gain, moderate to challenging; reserve the shuttle). I said bear spray is "not typically necessary". Food: Aspen Brewing Co, CP Burger, Meat & Cheese, Peach's Corner Cafe, Ajax Tavern, Element 47. Shopping: Galena St, Hyman Ave, Aspen Art Museum, Explore Booksellers. Drives: Independence Pass, Castle Creek Rd.
- **Boots**: recommended the **Merrell Moab 2 Mid Waterproof** and said it suits Yellowstone-type rock and the NZ trek. Alternatives: Salomon Quest 4D 3 GTX, Keen Targhee II Mid WP, La Sportiva, Hoka Speedgoat Mid 2 GTX.
- **Stove**: MSR PocketRocket 2, Jetboil Flash, Snow Peak LiteMax. Pot: MSR Titan or Snow Peak Titanium.
- **Water**: endorsed the **Sawyer Mini** for the 10-day NZ trek (2 oz, 0.1 micron, "100,000 gallons", backwash regularly).
- **Energy bites ratio: 2 cups rolled oats : 1/2 cup almond butter : 1/4 cup honey**, plus a pinch of salt. Chill 30 min, roll into 1-inch balls, makes **12–15**. Keeps 1 week in the fridge or 2 months frozen. Too dry → more honey; too sticky → more oats.
- **Smoothies**: Banana-Avocado Boost (1 banana, 1/2 avocado, 1/2 cup frozen pineapple, 1/2 cup unsweetened almond milk, 1 Tbsp honey, 1/2 tsp vanilla, ice). The user chose it and we **added 1 cup fresh spinach**. Others offered: Berry Bliss, Mango-Peach Delight, Green Goddess.

## 7 · Gotchas: likely errors in my earlier answers [assumed, not checked]
- The Sawyer Mini does **not** remove viruses (bacteria and protozoa only). For NZ backcountry that is usually fine, but say so if the user asks.
- "Hell's Revenge beginner route" and "Moab Rim, easy" are wrong: both are difficult. Better beginner options are Gemini Bridges and Long Canyon (easy to moderate). White Rim permits come from recreation.gov, and the "10 vehicles per group" figure is unverified.
- The Maroon Bells "Scenic Trail" is actually a short lakeside loop. The 10-mile figure fits Crater Lake or Buckskin Pass. Black bears do occur around Aspen, so carrying bear spray is reasonable.
- The hypothalamus is in the diencephalon, not the brainstem. Hovenweep and Zion drive times were rough guesses.
- Several restaurant and shop names in Aspen and Moab may not exist (e.g. "Aspen Kitchen", "The Coffee Lab", "Moab Bike Rentals"). Check them before vouching for them again.
